areas.name: Environmental sustainability, adaptation and mitigation
areas.reason: Urban parks and lagoons restored with nature-based solutions, plus strengthening of environmental policies, climate forum, training and reforestation.

areas.name: Basic sanitation
areas.reason: Macrodrainage works, retention basins and permeable surfaces prevent flooding, erosion and waterborne disease.

areas.name: Public-service delivery, management and citizen participation
areas.reason: Digital transformation of administrative and service processes: hardware and software, shorter waits, transparency, wider access and better service quality.

areas.name: Education and health conditions
areas.reason: Two products directly address school infrastructure and public health infrastructure (new and upgraded units).

areas.name: Energy efficiency and renewable energy
areas.reason: Renewable sources mentioned in some projects but not relevant overall; no dedicated component and small investment share.

areas.name: Integrated water-resources management and water security
Jobs and income for low-income and vulnerable groups

areas.name: Infrastructure and social facilities for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Mobility, leisure and park works benefit the general population, not specifically vulnerable groups.

areas.name: Youth, gender and race policies
areas.reason: Training and talks within pre-existing plans do not justify a score.
